I'm a principal data scientist at PyMC Labs, a consulting firm that specializes in
building Bayesian models to handle business problems. The firm grew out of the
open source project, [PyMC](https://www.pymc.io/welcome.html), a truly
wonderful piece of software.

In the recent past, I was a PhD student at the University of British Columbia in the
philosophy program. I worked on topics in evolutionary game theory, philosophy of science,
and cultural evolution. You can find my published work [here](https://scholar.google.ca/citations?user=GD912IAAAAAJ&hl=en&oi=sra).

I occasionally blog about related topics on this website.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
{
  const N = csv.columns.length;
  const hdrs = csv.columns;

  // Build 81x81 matrix from CSV
  const matrix = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < csv.length; i++) {
    const row = [];
    for (let j = 0; j < N; j++) {
      row.push(+csv[i][`column_${j}`]);
    }
    matrix.push(row);
  }

  // Normalize row to sum to 1
  const probs = matrix.map(row => {
    const s = d3.sum(row);
    return s > 0 ? row.map(v => v / s) : row;
  });

  // Precompute adjacency
  const adjFrom = probs.map(row =>
    row.map((v, j) => v > 0 ? j : -1).filter(j => j >= 0)
  );

  // Layout: same grid formula as transition-matrix.py
  const pos = {};
  let acc = 0;
  for (let R = 0; R < 3; R++) {
    for (let C = 0; C < 3; C++) {
      for (let mr = 0; mr < 3; mr++) {
        for (let mc = 0; mc < 3; mc++) {
          pos[acc] = { x: C * 3 + mc, y: 8 - R * 3 - mr };
          acc++;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // Coordinate mapping
  const PAD = 40;
  const SIZE = width - 2 * PAD;
  const HEIGHT = SIZE + 2 * PAD;
  const xSc = d3.scaleLinear().domain([0, 8]).range([PAD, PAD + SIZE]);
  const ySc = d3.scaleLinear().domain([0, 8]).range([PAD + SIZE, PAD]);
  const color = "#E95420";

  // SVG
  const svg = d3.create("svg")
    .attr("width", width)
    .attr("height", HEIGHT)
    .style("display", "block")
    .style("margin", "0 auto");

  // Edge layer
  const allEdges = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
    for (let j = 0; j < N; j++) {
      if (probs[i][j] > 0) allEdges.push({ source: i, target: j });
    }
  }

  const lines = svg.append("g")
    .selectAll("line").data(allEdges).join("line")
    .attr("x1", d => xSc(pos[d.source].x))
    .attr("y1", d => ySc(pos[d.source].y))
    .attr("x2", d => xSc(pos[d.target].x))
    .attr("y2", d => ySc(pos[d.target].y))
    .attr("stroke", "#a0a0a0")
    .attr("stroke-opacity", 0)
    .attr("stroke-width", 0.3)
    .attr("stroke-linecap", "round");

  // Node layer
  const circles = svg.append("g")
    .selectAll("circle").data(d3.range(N)).join("circle")
    .attr("cx", d => xSc(pos[d].x))
    .attr("cy", d => ySc(pos[d].y))
    .attr("r", 12)
    .attr("fill", "#a0a0a0")
    .attr("fill-opacity", 0)
    .attr("stroke", "none");

  // Helpers
  function sample(p) {
    const r = Math.random();
    let cum = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < p.length; i++) { cum += p[i]; if (r <= cum) return i; }
    return p.length - 1;
  }

  // Animation state
  let current = 0;
  const visited = new Set();
  visited.add(current);
  let alive = true;
  invalidation.then(() => { alive = false; });

  function update(transition = false) {
    const pSet = new Set(adjFrom[current]);
    const active = new Set([...visited, ...pSet]);

    const t = transition ? circles.transition().duration(400).ease(d3.easeCubicOut) : circles;
    const l = transition ? lines.transition().duration(400).ease(d3.easeCubicOut) : lines;

    // Edges
    l.attr("stroke-opacity", (_, i) => {
      const e = allEdges[i];
      if (e.source === current) return active.has(e.target) ? 0.6 : 0;
      if (visited.has(e.source) && visited.has(e.target)) return 0.25;
      return 0;
    })
    .attr("stroke-width", (_, i) => {
      const e = allEdges[i];
      return e.source === current ? 2.5 : 1.2;
    });

    // Nodes
    t.attr("fill", d => d === current ? color :
                         (pSet.has(d) || visited.has(d)) ? d3.interpolateRgb("#a0a0a0", color)(0.65) :
                         "#a0a0a0")
      .attr("fill-opacity", d => d === current ? 1.0 :
                                 (pSet.has(d) || visited.has(d)) ? 0.5 : 0)
      .attr("r", d => d === current ? 22 : (pSet.has(d) || visited.has(d)) ? 16 : 12);
  }

  update();

  // Main loop
  (async () => {
    while (alive) {
      await Promises.delay(1000); // Wait at current node
      const next = sample(probs[current]);
      current = next;
      visited.add(current);
      update(true); // Transition to the next state
    }
  })();

  return svg.node();
}
```
